missing: A tested comparison of dual-monitor KVMs and KVM docks for one laptop plus one desktop. It should list current prices and say whether each model takes a single USB-C/Thunderbolt cable from the laptop, charges it, and supports the refresh rate and resolution on both monitors with real switching behaviour (EDID, hotkeys). It should also cover laptops that support only one external display, like base MacBooks.
why: This search is open: no major reviewer or authority answers it. The Tom's Guide, TechRadar and PC Gamer results are monitor, laptop and mini PC guides that only mention built-in KVMs in passing. The pages that do answer it are niche sites: SolderMag picks KVMs by reasoning, and Setup Insider names one dual-monitor pick but focuses on single-monitor setups. Neither shows testing anyone can check. The rest are affiliate listicles or are about single-monitor or two-laptop setups. A focused dual-monitor laptop+desktop page with tested picks, current prices and clear cable and charging details would stand out.
